# Thunderbird Mail GUI Interface Description

## System and Window Management

- **Operating System Environment**: Linux desktop environment, likely GNOME, as indicated by the "Activities" button in the top-left corner.
- **Window Manager**: Standard Linux window manager with title bars, minimize/maximize/close buttons.
- **Top Bar**: Contains system information and application controls.
  - Left: "Activities" button.
  - Center: Application name "Thunderbird Mail".
  - Right: System date and time "Oct 23 00:12", system notification bell icon, and system control icons (sound, power).
- **Application Window Title**: "Write: (no subject) - Thunderbird" indicating an open email composition window.
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, and close buttons are visible in the top-right corner of the email composition window.

## Left Sidebar (Application Dock)

- **Application Icons**: Vertical dock on the left side of the screen.
  - Google Chrome browser icon.
  - Thunderbird Mail icon (currently active).
  - Visual Studio Code icon.
  - VLC media player icon.
  - LibreOffice Writer icon.
  - LibreOffice Calc icon.
  - LibreOffice Impress icon.
  - GIMP image editor icon.
  - File manager icon.
  - Ubuntu Software icon.
  - Help icon (question mark).
  - Trash icon.

## Main Thunderbird Interface

### Top Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Options, Tools, Help.
- **File Menu**: Currently open, displaying the following options:
  - New (with submenu indicator)
  - Attach (with submenu indicator)
  - Save (with keyboard shortcut Ctrl+S)
  - Save As (with submenu indicator)
  - Send Now (with keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Enter)
  - Send Later (with keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Shift+Enter)
  - Print... (with keyboard shortcut Ctrl+P)
  - Close (with keyboard shortcut Ctrl+W)

### Email Composition Area

- **Email Header Section**:
  - **From Field**: "enzi <mathias.gadenzi@gmail.com>" with a dropdown arrow indicating it can be changed.
  - **To Field**: "mathias.gadenzi@gmail.com" with a dropdown arrow.
  - **Cc Field**: "Cc" label.
  - **Bcc Field**: "Bcc" label.
  - **Attach Button**: Icon with "Attach" text and a dropdown arrow.
- **Email Body**:
  - **Text Area**: Large white area for composing the email message.
  - **Formatting Toolbar**: Located above the text area with the following icons:
    - Text alignment options (left, center, right, justify).
    - Font size options (T, T+, T-).
    - Bold (B), Italic (I), Underline (U).
    - Font color and background color options.
    - List options (unordered, ordered).
    - Indentation options.
    - Insert image icon.
    - Smiley face icon for emoticons.

### Right Panel (Welcome Screen)

- **Welcome Message**:
  - Title: "Welcome to FREEDOM"
  - Subtitle: "Thunderbird is a gift from thousands of people like you. We hope you'll enjoy the productivity, privacy, and freedom they make possible and we invite you to become part of that gift to others."
- **Donate Button**:
  - Blue button with a heart icon and text "Donate".
  - Subtext: "Help keep Thunderbird alive!"
- **Two Information Cards**:
  - **Free and Open Source Card**:
    - Title: "Free and Open Source"
    - Content: "Thunderbird is now yours forever. Thunderbird is developed openly and distributed freely. Our software license protects your right to use, modify, and share Thunderbird. Our mission is to protect your privacy and freedom."
    - Button: "Get Help" with a hand icon.
  - **Powered by Community Card**:
    - Title: "Powered by Community"
    - Content: "You can become part of our story. Anyone can contribute to Thunderbird. By donating, translating, answering questions, suggesting features, reporting bugs, and more, you make Thunderbird better for yourself and the world."
    - Button: "Participate" with a pencil icon.
- **Feature Announcement**:
  - Text: "Want new features sooner? Learn about Thunderbird Release."
  - Link: "Thunderbird Release" in blue text.

## Status and Navigation

- **Search Bar**: Located at the top of the main window, with placeholder text "Search..." and keyboard shortcut "CTRL + K".
- **Quick Filter**: Located to the right of the search bar.
- **Bottom Status Bar**:
  - Text: "( ) Done" indicating the status of the current task or action.
- **System Tray**: Located at the bottom of the screen, showing system status
